title: Malicious SHA-256 file hash a74f60e5deac… (OffSeq Mirage)
description: A malicious file identified by the SHA-256 hash a74f60e5deac9ecf7953ee0f855a5a493832b6b143141e75526bf954720f303f was observed twice on November 19, 2026, by OffSeq Mirage honeypot sensors. The file is associated with attacker activity involving the MITRE ATT&CK technique T1105 (Ingress Tool Transfer). The malicious payload could be a dropper, web shell, miner, or post-exploitation tool delivered or staged during the attack. The attacker infrastructure was located in Vietnam. This indicator can be used to detect the presence of this malicious file in environments by matching the hash against endpoint detection and response (EDR), antivirus (AV), and threat intelligence feeds.
